europe_now.title: Cost of Living Protests
europe_now.summary: Demonstrations regarding economic pressures and the cost of living have spread to multiple locations across Europe. Mass rallies have been reported in Spain as part of wider public discontent.

europe_now.title: EU-UK Summit and Post-Brexit Deals
europe_now.summary: The European Union and the United Kingdom have finalized a landmark agreement aimed at rebuilding diplomatic and economic ties. Analysts and officials are assessing the outcomes and potential impacts of the new arrangement.

top_stories.title: French Police Officers Sentenced
top_stories.summary: Parisian police officers have received prison sentences following legal proceedings related to the 2020 beating of a Black music producer. The high-profile case has drawn significant attention across French society and media.

top_stories.title: French Investigations and Legal Developments
top_stories.summary: Public figures including actor Gérard Depardieu have become subjects of ongoing legal scrutiny and sexual allegations investigations in France. Authorities continue to examine various high-profile inquiries involving cultural figures.
